classification.difficultyReason: Determine overtime from total hours and calculate total earnings at time-and-a-half without a supplied scaffold.

content.prompt: Maggie is paid \$42.70 per hour for a 38-hour week. She is paid overtime at time-and-a-half for any hours in excess of 38 hours. Calculate her total pay in a week in which she worked 55 hours.

answer.worked: $\begin{align*}\text{Overtime hours}&=55-38\\\text{Overtime hours}&=17\\\text{Normal pay}&=42.70\times38\\\text{Normal pay}&=\$1622.60\\\text{Overtime pay}&=42.70\times17\times1.5\\\text{Overtime pay}&=\$1088.85\\\text{Total pay}&=1622.60+1088.85\\\text{Total pay}&=\$2711.45\end{align*}$
